android.desc:
Resilient Maps is a fast, high-precision offline map application built for one purpose: maps you can rely on.

All maps are stored directly on your device and work entirely without an internet connection.

Key Features

Offline maps
Download detailed map packages and use them anywhere — no connection required.

Always available
Your maps continue to work in airplane mode, remote areas, and environments without coverage.

Smooth vector rendering
Clear, high-detail maps at all zoom levels with fast and responsive performance.

Privacy-friendly GPS
Your location is used only to show where you are — never stored, tracked, or shared.

Lightweight and reliable
Designed for hiking, travel, field work, and demanding outdoor use.

Enhanced map packages
Some regions include additional high-quality datasets such as terrain, environmental data, and official sources.

Built for resilience

Modern map apps often depend on constant connectivity and external services.
Resilient Maps takes a different approach.

Once a map is downloaded, it is stored locally on your device and remains available at all times — independent of network access, servers, or subscriptions.

Your maps are yours.
They don’t disappear, expire, or depend on someone else’s infrastructure.

Open Source

Resilient Maps is built on the open source TilelessMap engine, ensuring transparency and long-term reliability.
The full source code is available here:
https://gitlab.com/tilelessmap/tilelessmap

Privacy by Design

Resilient Maps collects no personal data, includes no analytics, and contains no tracking or advertising libraries.
All maps and settings stay on your device.

Reliable Navigation Anywhere

Whether you're exploring remote terrain, working in the field, or traveling off the grid, Resilient Maps provides a fast, precise, and trustworthy map experience — fully under your control.

quotes.text:
There is also https://gitlab.com/tilelessmap/tilelessmap with some of the same focus areas.

> TilelessMap is an open, offline-first mapping engine designed for critical field use,
such as forestry, emergency services, and humanitarian work.
Built with C and optimized for mobile performance, TilelessMap enables full local map
rendering without relying on cloud infrastructure — even in areas with poor or no
internet connectivity.

They have an Android app with maps of Yellowstone, Sweden and Norway.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.tileless.map.play
